summary.headline: Messahala on Astrological Interpretation
summary.text: Horary astrology examples assign questions about women, marriage, children, friends, fathers, kings, journeys, thieves, letters, wisdom, and dreams according to planetary positions. Messahala then identifies four causes of error in interpretation: faulty instruments or shadow measurements, an incompetent interrogator, uncertainty about the Sun’s passage from the midheaven, and equal strengths of fortunes and misfortunes.
